products.name: Second Hand Kymco Komfy 4 Mobility Scooter
products.description:
This Second hand Komfy mobility scooter has been designed to provide you with the ultimate in comfort style, maneuverability and performance. Designed with particular attention to ergonomics and comfort, Kymco Healthcare has developed one of the most flexible and easy to use scooters on the market.

Is it right for you?

The Komfy 4 is the ideal pavement scooter if comfort is your priority. The captain’s seat reclines, swivels 360°, and is upholstered in breathable fabric; adjustable suspension and pneumatic tyres absorb bumps with ease; and the ergonomic controls and clear display are perfect for hands that prefer simplicity. It also features a USB socket for your phone and rear splash guards for wet conditions.

It can travel up to 25 miles on a single charge, supports up to 25 stone, and with a top speed of 4 mph, it’s ready to go. This full-size scooter is designed for home use and charges conveniently overnight from a standard plug socket.

products.name: Second Hand Breeze S4 8mph Mobility Scooter
products.description:
This Second Hand TGA Breeze S4 8mph mobility scooter

Experience an ultra-smooth ride like never before, thanks to its full round motorcycle suspension and re-engineered shock absorbers. Even on bumpy paths, you’ll stay steady and comfortable, with stability levels that surpass anything you’ve seen before. Plus, it’s designed to support users weighing up to 31 stone, ensuring complete control over any terrain.

The rear transaxle motor packs a punch, delivering the power and performance you expect from a TGA Breeze. Whether you’re tackling slopes or cruising through town, it effortlessly handles slopes of up to 9 degrees.

Not only is it powerful, but it’s also nimble. The more compact chassis enhances manoeuvrability, making it perfect for navigating tight spaces around town.

Safety is paramount, with an advanced dual braking system that responds quickly in forward motion and engages automatically if the scooter rolls backward. And for a personalized fit, the ergonomically designed tiller can be finely adjusted to meet your exact needs.

Comfort is key, with a fully adjustable orthopaedic seat that now swivels 360 degrees for effortless side transfers.

Illuminate your path with powerful LED lights that conserve battery life by dimming when stationary. Plus, enjoy added visibility with indicators and an audible horn for added safety.

With its large alloy wheels and pneumatic tires, kerbs and rough terrain are a breeze, thanks to excellent ground clearance.

products.name: Second Hand Illusion Mobility Scooter
products.description:
This Second-hand Illusion is a revolutionary lightweight but strong scooter which can be disassembled into parts for easy lifting, the heaviest part weighing less than 10kg (similar to a bag of shopping) The complete chassis is manufactured from ultra-lightweight aircraft-grade aluminium for optimum durability, ensuring top quality. Taking around 30 seconds to reassemble it ensures you won’t be wasting any of your valuable time. It also features an ultra-lightweight lithium battery that is both accessible and simple to remove so you can easily move it to a preferred charging location.

A second charging port is located in the tiller which allows for easy access when disassembling is not needed. The scooter also has a powerful LED light for lower light driving conditions. The tiller is height adjustable, and the shallow floor plate helps provide exceptional legroom even for the taller users. Furthermore, not only super light, but the unique shrouding is also of contemporary design. The advanced engineered full front and rear suspension complete with the comfortable and spacious deep foam-covered seat gives a fantastically enjoyable driving experience. Together with the secure-grip delta handlebar, which gives you full control over manoeuvring the scooter and the Illusions many other key features, you can always be guaranteed a truly enjoyable and comfortable driving experience.
